ayahs.ar: الٓرٰࣞ كِتٰبٌ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ اِلَيۡكَ لِتُخۡرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَي النُّوۡرِ ࣢ۙ بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ اِلٰي صِرَاطِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَمِيۡدِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alif-Laaam-Raa; Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilaika litukhrijan-naasa minaz zulumaati ilan noori bi-izni Rabbihim ilaa siraatil 'Azeezil Hameed
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy -

ayahs.ar: اللّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ وَوَيۡلٌ لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ شَدِيۡدِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Allaahil lazee lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fill ard; wa wailul lilkaafireena min 'azaabin shadeed
ayahs.en: Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment

ayahs.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡتَحِبُّوۡنَ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا عَلَي الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبۡغُوۡنَهَا عِوَجًاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yastahibboo nal hayaatad dunyaa 'alal aakhirati wa yasuddoona 'ansabeelil laahi wa yabghoonahaa 'iwajaa; ulaaa 'ika fee dalaalim ba'eed
ayahs.en: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allah, seeking to make it (seem) deviant. Those are in extreme error.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوۡمِهٖ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمۡؕ فَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaa mir Rasoolin illaa bilisaani qawmihee liyubaiyina lahum faiudillul laahu mai yashaaa'u wa yahde mai yashaaa'; wa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allah sends astray [thereby] whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اَنۡ اَخۡرِجۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَي النُّوۡرِ ࣢ۙ وَذَكِّرۡهُمۡ بِاَيّٰىمِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi Aayaatinaa an akhrij qawmaka minaz zulumaati ilan noori wa zak kirhum bi ayyaamil laah; inna fee zaalika la aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
ayahs.en: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days of Allah." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِقَوۡمِهِ اذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَةَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اِذۡ اَنۡجٰىكُمۡ مِّنۡ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُوۡمُوۡنَكُمۡ سُوۡٓءَ الۡعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُوۡنَ اَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُوۡنَ نِسَآءَكُمۡؕ وَفِيۡ ذٰلِكُمۡ بَلَآءٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaala Moosaa liqawmihiz kuroo ni'matal laahi 'alaikum iz anjaakum min Aali Fir'awna yasoomoo nakum sooo'al 'azaabi wa yuzabbihoona abnaaa'akum wa yastahyoona nisaaa'akum; wa fee zaalikum balaaa'um mir Rabbikum 'azeem
ayahs.en: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to His people, "Remember the favor of Allah upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ تَاَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَئِنۡ شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَاَزِيۡدَنَّكُمۡ وَلَئِنۡ كَفَرۡتُمۡ اِنَّ عَذَابِيۡ لَشَدِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz ta azzana Rabbukum la'in shakartum la azeedannakum wa la'in kafartum inn'azaabee lashadeed
ayahs.en: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.' "

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡتُمۡ وَمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًاۙ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Moosaaa in takfurooo antum wa man fil ardi jamee'an fa innal laaha la Ghaniyyun Hameed
ayahs.en: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy."

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُا الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ قَوۡمِ نُوۡحٍ وَّعَادٍ وَّثَمُوۡدَ ࣢ؕۛ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡؕۛ لَا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ اِلَّا اللّٰهُؕ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَرَدُّوۡ٘ا اَيۡدِيَهُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡ وَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كَفَرۡنَا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ وَاِنَّا لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ مُرِيۡبٍ
ayahs.tl: Alam yaatikum naba'ul lazeena min qablikum qawmi Noohinw wa 'Aadinw wa Samood, wallazeena mim ba'dihim; laa ya'lamuhum illallaah; jaaa'at hum Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati faraddooo aydiyahum feee afwaahihim wa qaalooo innaa kafarnaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee wa innaa lafee shakkim mimmaa tad'oonanaaa ilaihi mureeb
ayahs.en: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud and those after them? No one knows them but Allah. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths and said, "Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ اَفِي اللّٰهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ يَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذُنُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمۡ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَاؕ تُرِيۡدُوۡنَ اَنۡ تَصُدُّوۡنَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا فَاۡتُوۡنَا بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat Rusuluhum afillaahi shakkun faatiris samaawaati wal ardi yad'ookum liyaghfira lakum min zunoobikum wa yu'akhkhirakum ilaaa ajalim musam maa; qaaloo in antum illaa basharum mislunaa tureedoona an tasuddoonaa 'ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaaa'unaa faatoonaa bisul taanim mubeen
ayahs.en: Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays your death for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority."

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ لَهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ اِنۡ نَّحۡنُ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ وَلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَمُنُّ عَلٰي مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖؕ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّاۡتِيَكُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَعَلَي اللّٰهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat lahum Rusuluhum in nahnu illaa basharum mislukum wa laakinnal laaha yamunnu 'alaa mai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadihee wa maa kaana lanaaa an naatiyakum bisul taanin illaa bi iznil laah; wa 'alal laahi falyatawakkalil mu'minonn
ayahs.en: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allah confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لَنَا٘ اَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ وَقَدۡ هَدٰىنَا سُبُلَنَاؕ وَلَنَصۡبِرَنَّ عَلٰي مَا٘ اٰذَيۡتُمُوۡنَاؕ وَعَلَي اللّٰهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُتَوَكِّلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa lanaa allaa natawakkala 'alal laahi wa qad hadaanaa subulanaa; wa lanasbiranna 'alaa maaa aazaitumoonaa; wa 'alal laahi falyatawakkalil mutawakkiloon
ayahs.en: And why should we not rely upon Allah while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allah let those who would rely [indeed] rely."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِرُسُلِهِمۡ لَنُخۡرِجَنَّكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِنَا٘ اَوۡ لَتَعُوۡدُنَّ فِيۡ مِلَّتِنَاؕ فَاَوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ لَنُهۡلِكَنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo li Rusulihim lanukhrijanna kum min aardinaaa aw lata'oo dunna fee millatinaa fa awhaaa ilaihim Rabbuhum lanuhlikannaz zalimeen
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَنُسۡكِنَنَّكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡؕ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامِيۡ وَخَافَ وَعِيۡدِ
ayahs.tl: Wa lanuskinan nakumul arda mim ba'dihim; zaalika liman khaafa maqaamee wa khaafa wa'eed
ayahs.en: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat."

ayahs.ar: وَاسۡتَفۡتَحُوۡا وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيۡدٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wastaftahoo wa khaaba kullu jabbaarin 'aneed
ayahs.en: And they requested victory from Allah, and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.

ayahs.ar: مِّنۡ وَّرَآئِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسۡقٰي مِنۡ مَّآءٍ صَدِيۡدٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Minw waraaa'ihee jahannamu wa yusqaa mim maaa'in sadeed
ayahs.en: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.

ayahs.ar: يَّتَجَرَّعُهٗ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيۡغُهٗ وَيَاۡتِيۡهِ الۡمَوۡتُ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَّمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍؕ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآئِهٖ عَذَابٌ غَلِيۡظٌ
ayahs.tl: Yatajarra'uhoo wa laa yakaadu yuseeghuhoo wa yaateehil mawtu min kulli makaaninw wa maa huwa bimaiyitinw wa minw waraaa'ihee 'azaabun ghaleez
ayahs.en: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.

ayahs.ar: مَثَلُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِرَبِّهِمۡ اَعۡمَالُهُمۡ كَرَمَادِ اِۨشۡتَدَّتۡ بِهِ الرِّيۡحُ فِيۡ يَوۡمٍ عَاصِفٍؕ لَا يَقۡدِرُوۡنَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوۡا عَلٰي شَيۡءٍؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلٰلُ الۡبَعِيۡدُ
ayahs.tl: Masalul lazeena kafaroo bi Rabbihim a'maaluhum karamaadinish taddat bihir reehu fee yawmin 'aasif; laa yaqdiroona mimmaa kasaboo 'alaa shai'; zaalika huwad dalaalul ba'eed
ayahs.en: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّؕ اِنۡ يَّشَاۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَاۡتِ بِخَلۡقٍ جَدِيۡدٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara annal laaha khalaqas samaawaati wal arda bilhaqq; iny yashaa yuzhibkum wa yaati bikhalqin jadeed
ayahs.en: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.

ayahs.ar: وَّمَا ذٰلِكَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ بِعَزِيۡزٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa zaalika 'alal laahi bi 'azeez
ayahs.en: And that is not difficult for Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَبَرَزُوۡا لِلّٰهِ جَمِيۡعًا فَقَالَ الضُّعَفٰٓؤُا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعًا فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّغۡنُوۡنَ عَنَّا مِنۡ عَذَابِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ قَالُوۡا لَوۡ هَدٰىنَا اللّٰهُ لَهَدَيۡنٰكُمۡؕ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَا٘ اَجَزِعۡنَا٘ اَمۡ صَبَرۡنَا مَا لَنَا مِنۡ مَّحِيۡصٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa barazoo lillaahi jamee'an faqaalad du'afaaa'u lillazeenas takbarooo innaa kunnaa lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona 'annaa min 'azaabil laahi min shai'; qaaloo law hadaanal laahu lahadai naakum sawaaa'un 'alainaaa ajazi'naa am sabarnaa maa lanaa mim mahees
ayahs.en: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allah all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allah?" They will say, "If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ الۡاَمۡرُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَعَدَكُمۡ وَعۡدَ الۡحَقِّ وَوَعَدۡتُّكُمۡ فَاَخۡلَفۡتُكُمۡؕ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ دَعَوۡتُكُمۡ فَاسۡتَجَبۡتُمۡ لِيۡۚ فَلَا تَلُوۡمُوۡنِيۡ وَلُوۡمُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَكُمۡؕ مَا٘ اَنَا بِمُصۡرِخِكُمۡ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُصۡرِخِيَّؕ اِنِّيۡ كَفَرۡتُ بِمَا٘ اَشۡرَكۡتُمُوۡنِ مِنۡ قَبۡلُؕ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalash Shaitaanu lammaa qudiyal amru innal laaha wa'adakum wa'dal haqqi wa wa'attukum faakhlaftukum wa maa kaana liya 'alaikum min sultaanin illaaa an da'awtukum fastajabtum lee falaa taloomoonee wa loomooo anfusakum maaa ana bimusrikhikum wa maaa antum bimusrikhiyya innee kafartu bimaaa ashraktumooni min qabl; innaz zaalimeena lahum azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allah had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allah] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."

ayahs.ar: وَاُدۡخِلَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡؕ تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ فِيۡهَا سَلٰمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa udkhilal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati Jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa bi izni Rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feeha salaam
ayahs.en: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ اَصۡلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَّفَرۡعُهَا فِي السَّمَآءِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara kaifa darabal laahu masalan kalimatan taiyibatan kashajaratin taiyibatin asluhaa saabitunw wa far'uhaa fis samaaa'
ayahs.en: Have you not considered how Allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?

ayahs.ar: تُؤۡتِيۡ٘ اُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِيۡنٍۭ بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهَاؕ وَيَضۡرِبُ اللّٰهُ الۡاَمۡثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Tu'teee ukulahaa kulla heenim bi izni Rabbihaa; wa yadribul laahul amsaala linnaasi la'allahum yatazak karoon
ayahs.en: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allah presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.

ayahs.ar: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيۡثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيۡثَةِ اِۨجۡتُثَّتۡ مِنۡ فَوۡقِ الۡاَرۡضِ مَا لَهَا مِنۡ قَرَارٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa masalu kalimatin khabeesatin kashajaratin khabee satinij tussat min fawqil ardi maa lahaa min qaraar
ayahs.en: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.

ayahs.ar: يُثَبِّتُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِالۡقَوۡلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَفِي الۡاٰخِرَةِۚ وَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَࣞۙ وَيَفۡعَلُ اللّٰهُ مَا يَشَآءُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yusabbitul laahul lazeena aamanoo bilqawlis saabiti fil hayaatid dunyaa wa fil Aakhirati wa yudillul laahuz zaalimeen; wa yaf'alul laahu maa yashaaa'
ayahs.en: Allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allah sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allah does what He wills.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ بَدَّلُوۡا نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ كُفۡرًا وَّاَحَلُّوۡا قَوۡمَهُمۡ دَارَ الۡبَوَارِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara ilal lazeena baddaloo ni'matal laahi kufranw wa ahalloo qawmahum daaral bawaar
ayahs.en: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?

ayahs.ar: جَهَنَّمَۚ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَاؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرَارُ
ayahs.tl: Jahannama yaslawnahaa wa bi'sal qaraar
ayahs.en: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلُوۡا لِلّٰهِ اَنۡدَادًا لِّيُضِلُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِهٖؕ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعُوۡا فَاِنَّ مَصِيۡرَكُمۡ اِلَي النَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'aloo lillaahi andaadal liyudilloo 'an sabeelih; qul tamatta'oo fa innaa maseerakum ilan Naar
ayahs.en: And they have attributed to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لِّعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا يُقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ سِرًّا وَّعَلَانِيَةً مِّنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَ يَوۡمٌ لَّا بَيۡعٌ فِيۡهِ وَلَا خِلٰلٌ
ayahs.tl: Qul li'ibaadiyal lazeena aamanoo yuqeemus Salaata wa yunfiqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirranw wa 'alaaniyatam min qabli any yaatiya Yawmul laa bai'un feehi wa laa khilaal
ayahs.en: [O Muhammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange, nor any friendships.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَاَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَخۡرَجَ بِهٖ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ رِزۡقًا لَّكُمۡۚ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الۡفُلۡكَ لِتَجۡرِيَ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ بِاَمۡرِهٖۚ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الۡاَنۡهٰرَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Allaahul lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda wa anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an faakhraja bihee minas samaraati rizqal lakum wa sakhkhara lakumul fulka litajriya fil bahri bi amrihee wa sakhkhara lakumul anhaar
ayahs.en: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.

ayahs.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيۡنِۚ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa sakhkhara lakumush shamsa walqamara daaa'ibaini wa sakhkhara lakumul laila wannahaar
ayahs.en: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰتٰىكُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ مَا سَاَلۡتُمُوۡهُؕ وَاِنۡ تَعُدُّوۡا نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ لَا تُحۡصُوۡهَاؕ اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لَظَلُوۡمٌ كَفَّارٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa aataakum min kulli maa sa altumooh; wa in ta'uddoo ni'matal laahi laa tuhsoohaa; innal insaana lazaloo mun kaffaar
ayahs.en: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡ هٰذَا الۡبَلَدَ اٰمِنًا وَّاجۡنُبۡنِيۡ وَبَنِيَّ اَنۡ نَّعۡبُدَ الۡاَصۡنَامَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaala Ibraaheemu Rabbij 'al haazal balada aaminanw wajnubnee wa baniyya an na'budal asnaam
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ اِنَّهُنَّ اَضۡلَلۡنَ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِۚ فَمَنۡ تَبِعَنِيۡ فَاِنَّهٗ مِنِّيۡۚ وَمَنۡ عَصَانِيۡ فَاِنَّكَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Rabbi innahunna adlalna kaseeram minan naasi faman tabi'anee fa innahoo minnee wa man 'asaanee fa innaka Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا٘ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَسۡكَنۡتُ مِنۡ ذُرِّيَّتِيۡ بِوَادٍ غَيۡرِ ذِيۡ زَرۡعٍ عِنۡدَ بَيۡتِكَ الۡمُحَرَّمِۙ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ فَاجۡعَلۡ اَفۡـِٕدَةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ تَهۡوِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ وَارۡزُقۡهُمۡ مِّنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Rabbanaaa inneee askantu min zurriyyatee biwaadin ghairi zee zar'in 'inda Baitikal Muharrami Rabbanaa liyuqeemus Salaata faj'al af'idatam minan naasi tahweee ilaihim warzuqhum minas samaraati la'allahum yashkuroon
ayahs.en: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا٘ اِنَّكَ تَعۡلَمُ مَا نُخۡفِيۡ وَمَا نُعۡلِنُؕ وَمَا يَخۡفٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَآءِ
ayahs.tl: Rabbanaaa innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee wa maa nu'lin; wa maa yakhfaa 'alal laahi min shai'in fil ardi wa laa fis samaaa'
ayahs.en: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.

ayahs.ar: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ وَهَبَ لِيۡ عَلَي الۡكِبَرِ اِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِسۡحٰقَؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ لَسَمِيۡعُ الدُّعَآءِ
ayahs.tl: Alhamdu lillaahil lazee wahaba lee 'alal kibari Ismaa'eela wa Ishaaq; inna Rabbee lasamee'ud du'aaa
ayahs.en: Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡنِيۡ مُقِيۡمَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَمِنۡ ذُرِّيَّتِيۡࣗۖ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
ayahs.tl: Rabbij 'alnee muqeemas Salaati wa min zurriyyatee Rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aaa'
ayahs.en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ يَوۡمَ يَقُوۡمُ الۡحِسَابُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Rabbanagh fir lee wa liwaalidaiya wa lilmu'mineena Yawma yaqoomul hisaab
ayahs.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ اللّٰهَ غَافِلًا عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ ࣢ؕ اِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٍ تَشۡخَصُ فِيۡهِ الۡاَبۡصَارُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tahsabannal laaha ghaafilan 'ammaa ya'maluz zaalimoon; innamaa yu'akh khiruhum li Yawmin tashkhasu feehil absaar
ayahs.en: And never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].

ayahs.ar: مُهۡطِعِيۡنَ مُقۡنِعِيۡ رُءُوۡسِهِمۡ لَا يَرۡتَدُّ اِلَيۡهِمۡ طَرۡفُهُمۡۚ وَاَفۡـِٕدَتُهُمۡ هَوَآءٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Muhti'eena muqni'ee ru'oosihim laa yartaddu ilaihim tarfuhum wa af'idatuhum hawaaa'
ayahs.en: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنۡذِرِ النَّاسَ يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِيۡهِمُ الۡعَذَابُ فَيَقُوۡلُ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا رَبَّنَا٘ اَخِّرۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ قَرِيۡبٍۙ نُّجِبۡ دَعۡوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَؕ اَوَلَمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡ٘ا اَقۡسَمۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ زَوَالٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa anzirin naasa Yawma yaateehimul 'azaabu fa yaqoolul lazeena zalamoo Rabbanaaa akhkhirnaaa ilaaa ajalin qareebin nujib da'wataka wa nattabi 'ir Rusul; awalam takoonooo aqsamtum min qablu maa lakum min zawaal
ayahs.en: And, [O Muhammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?

ayahs.ar: وَّسَكَنۡتُمۡ فِيۡ مَسٰكِنِ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ فَعَلۡنَا بِهِمۡ وَضَرَبۡنَا لَكُمُ الۡاَمۡثَالَ
ayahs.tl: Wa sakantum fee masaakinil lazeena zalamooo anfusahum wa tabaiyana lakum kaifa fa'alnaa bihim wa darabnaa lakumul amsaal
ayahs.en: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."

ayahs.ar: وَقَدۡ مَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرَهُمۡ وَعِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ مَكۡرُهُمۡؕ وَاِنۡ كَانَ مَكۡرُهُمۡ لِتَزُوۡلَ مِنۡهُ الۡجِبَالُ
ayahs.tl: Wa qad makaroo makrahum wa 'indal laahi makruhum wa in kaana makruhum litazoola minhul jibaal
ayahs.en: And they had planned their plan, but with Allah is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِفَ وَعۡدِهٖ رُسُلَهٗؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيۡزٌ ذُو انۡتِقَامٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Falaa tahsabannal laaha mukhlifa wa'dihee Rusulah; innal laaha 'azeezun zuntiqaam
ayahs.en: So never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ تُبَدَّلُ الۡاَرۡضُ غَيۡرَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ وَبَرَزُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الۡوَاحِدِ الۡقَهَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Yawma tubaddalul ardu ghairal ardi wassamaawaatu wa barazoo lillaahil Waahidil Qahhaar
ayahs.en: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and all creatures will come out before Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَي الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ مُّقَرَّنِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَصۡفَادِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa taral mujrimeena Yawma 'izim muqarraneena filasfaad
ayahs.en: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in shackles,

ayahs.ar: سَرَابِيۡلُهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَطِرَانٍ وَّتَغۡشٰي وُجُوۡهَهُمُ النَّارُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Saraabeeluhum min qatiraaninw wa taghshaa wujoohahumun Naar
ayahs.en: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire.

ayahs.ar: لِيَجۡزِيَ اللّٰهُ كُلَّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتۡؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيۡعُ الۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.tl: Liyajziyal laahu kulla nafsim maa kasabat; innal laaha saree'ul hisaab
ayahs.en: So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا بَلٰغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنۡذَرُوۡا بِهٖ وَلِيَعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّمَا هُوَ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ وَّلِيَذَّكَّرَ اُولُوا الۡاَلۡبَابِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Haaza balaaghul linnaasi wa liyunzaroo bihee wa liya'lamooo annamaa Huwa Illaahunw Waahidunw wa liyaz zakkara ulul albaab
ayahs.en: This [Qur'an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
